# Model Card — rul_transformer_cmapss

**Status**: TRAINED — **Transformer-encoder Remaining-Useful-Life (RUL) regressor** on the real **NASA
C-MAPSS FD001** benchmark. Stage 8 depth-hardening of the PREDICT step (KB_25 step 1). Replaces the toy
1-layer SimWorld LSTM's *architecture* with the attention-based design the RUL literature uses, and — the
key point — reports a **real public-benchmark RMSE/score** comparable to published numbers.

## Overview
- **Name**: `rul_transformer_cmapss` · weights `models/rul_transformer_cmapss.pt` · metrics `…metrics.json`.
- **Role**: forecast **remaining-useful-life (cycles)** for a turbofan engine from a 30-cycle window of 14
  sensor channels. The deepened, benchmark-validated PREDICT model. **Not** a certified safety function.
- **Inference**: `backend/ml/rul_transformer.py::RULTransformer.predict_rul(window)`. Honest: raises
  `ModelUnavailableError` if torch/weights absent — never fabricates. Loaded with
  `torch.load(weights_only=True)`. The wrapper applies the train-fit min-max scaler internally.
- **Architecture**: input Linear(14→64) → fixed sinusoidal positional encoding → 2× `TransformerEncoderLayer`
  (d_model 64, 4 heads, FFN 128, GELU, dropout 0.1, batch-first) → temporal mean-pool → MLP head → scalar RUL.
  Single source of truth: `build_rul_transformer(...)` (shared by trainer + inference).

## Training
- **Data**: **NASA C-MAPSS FD001** (Saxena & Goebel 2008) — 100 train engines run to failure, 100 test
  engines truncated, with ground-truth RUL for each test engine's last cycle. Single operating condition /
  single fault mode. Downloaded from two public mirrors (recorded in metrics `mirrors`), unmodified, cached
  under repo-root `data/datasets/cmapss/` (git-ignored — real dataset binaries live behind DVC, not git).
- **Preprocessing (standard, leakage-free)**: 14 informative sensors (the 7 constant sensors + 3 near-constant
  op-settings dropped); per-sensor **min-max fit on TRAIN only**; **piecewise-linear RUL with cap Rc=125**
  (the canonical early-life clip); sliding windows length 30 (17,731 train windows). Engine-level 85/15
  train/val split for best-checkpoint selection (no test peeking).
- **Optimisation**: MSE loss (learns the RUL scale fast where Huber crawls), Adam lr 1e-3, cosine schedule,
  batch 512, 40 epochs, seed 8, head-bias warm-started at the mean train RUL. ~265 s CPU.
- **Reproduce**: `python training/stage_08_world_model/train_cmapss.py --epochs 40 --batch 512`.

## Evaluation (MEASURED 2026-06-14, official 100 FD001 test engines, single eval)
| Metric | Value | Baseline / reference |
|---|---|---|
| **Test RMSE** | **13.80** | naive mean-RUL baseline **40.55** (+66.0%) |
| **Test NASA score** | **372** | naive baseline 18,366 |
| best-val RMSE | 13.17 | (model-selection metric) |

**Literature FD001 test RMSE (cited, NOT reproduced here):** CNN 18.45 (Babu 2016) · LSTM 16.14 (Zheng 2017)
· DCNN 12.61 (Li 2018) · AGCNN 12.42 (Liu 2020) · Transformer 11.27 (Mo 2021). Our honest **13.80 beats the
classic CNN and LSTM baselines and is competitive with the DCNN/Transformer SOTA** — a real, comparable
benchmark number, not a near-trivial-signal score. Re-eval through the public glue:
`python training/stage_08_world_model/eval_cmapss.py` (→ `training/evals/stage08/cmapss_results.*`).

## Limitations & honest scope
- **FD001 is a single operating-condition / single fault-mode benchmark.** It validates the architecture and
  training pipeline; it is NOT this project's plant. Generalisation to a real fleet still requires re-fit on
  real telemetry (**G-035**).
- RMSE/score computed **once** on the official test set after best-val selection — no test-set tuning. The
  number is reported as-measured (slightly above the ~11–13 published SOTA; not claimed to beat it).
- Not wired to any actuator; the Stage-17 functional-safety wrapper must precede any real-world use.
- The original `world_model_ttf` SimWorld LSTM is retained for the live-loop TTF signal; this C-MAPSS
  Transformer is the benchmark-grade PREDICT deepening (real, comparable numbers).

## Companion deepenings (Stage 8, 2026-06-14)
- **Learned causal discovery** (`backend/ml/causal_discovery.py`, causal-learn PC): recovers crack_proximity
  as the common-cause hub from SimWorld data (skeleton F1 0.75, 4/5 hub edges) — empirically validating the
  known-SCM counterfactual in `services/diagnosis.py`. Report: `training/evals/stage08/causal_discovery.json`.
- **Neuro-symbolic plan verifier** (`backend/services/plan_verifier.py`): the symbolic constraint engine of
  KB_25's VERIFY step (crew/throughput/redundancy/precondition contracts; rejects unsafe plans).
